diagnosis.observed: After the whole prod-local root had been removed from a reused Windows checkout, WSL DrvFs reported the name absent to lookup but returned EEXIST to mkdir. Windows CreateDirectory could recreate each component. Docker bind recreation as root then made the tree visible but not writable by the WSL user.
diagnosis.classification: Testermint infrastructure setup failure; it is not evidence that the contract accepted or rejected Refund.
diagnosis.related_history: The same exception class was recorded by a8-negative-019 and a8-negative-020 before later bind-mount mitigations.
diagnosis.fix: Always reset and create the bind tree through Docker as root, then chown it back to the current Unix UID:GID before JVM writes.

acceptance_effect: This run remains NOT RUN for Refund. Its infrastructure blocker was later fixed and does not itself contribute contract PASS evidence.
